title: Tuples and Sets: Fixed Groups and Unique Items

ai_pair_moment.flaw: Asked for code with an empty set called seen, the AI wrote `seen = {}` and promised three welcomes and `New today: 3`. Empty curly brackets make a dictionary, which has no `add()`, so the program stopped with `AttributeError: 'dict' object has no attribute 'add'` after the first welcome. Step 5 of the lesson catches it; `seen = set()` fixes it.

changes: Every example prints sorted(...) instead of a set, because the printed order of a set of strings can change between runs.
remove() on a set, frozenset, set comprehensions and the tuple methods count() and index() are left out to keep one new idea per step; comprehensions follow in Chapter 14.
The unpacking error is checked by its shared part only, because newer Python versions add how many values they got.

The AI section adds verified files for each stage: a worked example of one line, the pair moment, two test cases (one welcomes Omar twice), a typing error in the debug stage, a run of every case again, and a suggestion that removes every welcome.
outstanding_issues: The tracebacks show the short file name; on a learner's computer the full path appears instead.
The narration uses a synthetic voice (Kokoro bm_lewis). The owner should watch the video once and flag any word the voice mispronounces; fixes go in the PRONOUNCE list in tools/voice.py.
